title: Late-1950s craft that could reach the moon without rockets

tellings.quote: when in the late 50s we had things that could go to the moon and back without a rocket.

plain: By the late 1950s, the United States is said to have had craft that could fly to the moon and back without any rocket. A researcher named Steven Greer makes this claim without naming a source, as part of his case that advanced technology has been held back by a hidden group.
